description: Controlled-ally G2 gate: spawn a line of hostiles, Dominate the nearest, and confirm the converted ally engages the other hostiles (control_acquired + control_attack in the server log).
notes: Two+ hostiles are required so the converted ally has a target other than the caster; test mobs line spawns three Test_Dummy_Stationary in front.
control_acquired and control_attack are emitted as [MOTM] server log lines by ControlHytaleAdapter; assert them from the log, not as causality evidence (yet).
